announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Marietta, Georgia, has been awarded a $287,192,281.00 modification (P00014) to the previously awarded contract FA8625-14-C-6450 for an additional five C-130J type aircraft. The contract modification provides for the purchase of an additional quantity of aircraft being produced under the basic contract. Work will be performed at Marietta, Georgia, and is expected to be complete by Apr. 30, 2020. Fiscal 2014, 2015 and 2016 Air Force aircraft procurement funds; fiscal 2016 Marine Corps Navy aircraft procurement funds; fiscal 2016 Marine Corps Navy aircraft advance procurement funds; fiscal 2015 overseas contingency operations funds in the amount of $287,192,281 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Load King, LLC, Elk Point, South Dakota (W56HZV-16-D-0016); and Schutt Industries of Clintonville, Wisconsin, Inc.*, Clintonville, Wisconsin (W56HZV-16-D-0017); will share a $187,929,988 firm-fixed-price contract for M870A4 semitrailers including a low rate initial production quantity of 11 trailers; and a subsequent full rate production quantity up to the maximum of 1,350 trailers. Bids were solicited via the internet with six received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Aug. 26, 2023. Army Contracting Command, Warren, Michigan, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Grand Prairie, Texas, is being awarded a $19,872,914 modification (P00023) to a previously awarded fixed-price contract. The value of this modification is $19,872,914, increasing the total contract value from $896,669,237 to $916,542,151. Under this modification, the contractor will produce two additional Lot 8 Interceptors and provide associated production support efforts for the Missile Defense Agency Terminal High Altitude Area Defense Project Office under fixed-price incentive-firm target contract line item numbers. The work will be performed in Grand Prairie, Texas; Huntsville, Alabama; Anniston, Alabama; Camden, Arkansas; and Troy, Alabama. The performance period is through Oct. 31, 2019. Fiscal 2016 procurement funds in the amount of $19,872,914 are being obligated on this award. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (# HQ0147-14-C-0011).
